data.rule_text: Dealers must upload warranty documentation to OLDP within 10 days post-repair.
Claims not submitted within 90 days post-repair will generally not be honored unless approved by SDLG.
Claims submitted before the 22nd of each month are reviewed by SDLG by the 25th of that month.

calculation.formula: submission_date <= monthly day 22 => review by day 25

data.rule_text: Physical inspections must be conducted within 12 months following photo review.
Conclusions must be issued within 30 days of the physical inspection.
Timeliness of service information submission (repairs, inspections, etc.) is measured against a 7-day target, with 90% target compliance for scoring.
Mandatory maintenance documentation must be submitted to OLDP within 10 business days post-service.
Warranty coverage of the entire unit is determined based on the date the malfunction occurred.
Dealers and customers must use genuine SDLG parts for repairs and maintenance; non-genuine parts void warranty coverage for that part and related system components.
Faulty parts replaced under warranty must be stored for no less than 6 months unless otherwise instructed.
Approved machine repair claims are settled every 6 months using the exchange rate prevailing on settlement date.
Indonesia (Indonesia / 印尼) has country coefficient 0.7.
Hourly labor rate for excavator warranty claims is $35/hour.

data.topic: Loader and road machinery warranty claim labor rate
data.rule_text: Hourly labor rate for loaders and road machinery warranty claims is $25/hour.
Repair parts cost formula uses damaged parts FOB price × 140% × CAF coefficient.
Mileage subsidy is segmented by round-trip distance; the maximum subsidy per repair order is $170 USD for the standard warranty claim mileage schedule.
Communication expense subsidy standard is $2/session.
Mandatory maintenance hourly wage subsidy is $15/hour for dealers using SDLG-specific oil.
Mandatory maintenance mileage subsidy has a maximum of $110 USD per repair order under the stated round-trip schedule.
$1,500 per eligible person per year; one year service and TCL3/TCL4 required; maximum eligible people depends on 5-year installed base.
Inventory exceeding 3 months requires monthly inspection and maintenance.
Before machine sale, dealer must conduct Pre-Delivery Inspection.
After inventory maintenance or PDI, dealer must promptly enter information into OLDP; missing submission removes subsidy eligibility and voids machine warranty rights.
Faulty parts replaced under warranty must be stored at dealer service center for no less than 6 months unless otherwise instructed.
Engine fault claims require engine nameplate and faulty component nameplate photos, except special circumstances.
Cases determinable from warranty information and photos are Photo Review cases.
Cases not determinable through Photo Review and requiring physical item/personnel inspection are Physical Inspection cases.
Inconclusive Photo Review cases become pending and temporarily denied until Physical Review outcome.
Claims failing either photo or physical inspection will not be compensated.
Labor, transportation, repair materials and communication for SDLG-initiated market product improvements use 1.1 times standard rates.
Repairs using remanufactured parts are reimbursed at half of remanufactured part FOB price.
Parts quality claims reimbursed at 180% of SDLG FOB price; no other expenses covered.
SDLG provides three maintenance subsidies during warranty period at 1000h/2000h/3000h intervals.
Dealers shall not charge customers labor or mileage fees for the three subsidized maintenance sessions; only material costs may be collected.
Core/key customers eligible for no more than one visit per month and three visits per year.
Indonesia dealers procure parts through PTSDLG warehouse and submit monthly inventory/retail sales reports.
Discrepancies found in dead-parts subsidy audits result in double recovery of compensation payments.
Cancellation loss fee exemptions include system malfunction, customer procurement cycle >90 days, and SDLG Aftermarket stock shortage/excessive procurement cycle.
Shandong Lingong has final authority to interpret this policy.
